audience: merchants who sell on marketplaces and webshops through ChannelEngine

useCases.title: Take in new orders
useCases.text: Get the orders that are new and not yet processed. Acknowledge each order to tell the channel that you accepted it.

useCases.title: Check stock across locations
useCases.text: List the stock locations, then read the stock level of each product across all of them.

useCases.title: Set stock for products
useCases.text: Send the full stock per location for each product. The change updates live listings on every connected channel.

useCases.title: Review returns and cancellations
useCases.text: List the returns, with filters on channel, order, status, date and acknowledgement. List the order cancellations, with filters on creation date and order numbers.

useCases.title: See which products a channel lists
useCases.text: List the channels, then list the products on one channel for the product numbers you choose.
